question: Where was the first women's international test cricket match hosted in India in 1976?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangalore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first women's international test cricket match hosted in India took place in **Bangalore** in 1976.
 
• This match was a significant milestone in the history of women's cricket in India.
 
• It marked the beginning of international women's cricket matches being played on Indian soil.
 
• Bangalore, known for its rich cricketing culture, provided a great platform for this historic event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Women's Test Cricket**

 
 
• Women's Test cricket is the longest form of women's cricket and is considered the ultimate test of a player's endurance and skill.
 
• The first women's Test match was played between England and Australia in December 1934.
 
• Test matches are played over four days, unlike men's Test matches which are played over five days.
 
• Test cricket is governed by the International Cricket Council (ICC), which is the global governing body for the sport of cricket.
 
 
 
• **History of Women's Cricket in India**
 
 
• Women's cricket in India has a rich history, with the first recorded match being played in the early 1970s.
 
• The Women's Cricket Association of India (WCAI) was formed in 1973 to promote and develop women's cricket in the country.
 
• The Indian women's cricket team played its first Test match in 1976 against the West Indies.
 
• Over the years, women's cricket in India has grown significantly, with the team achieving considerable success in international tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Bangalore**
 
 
• Bangalore, now known as Bengaluru, is the capital city of the Indian state of Karnataka.
 
• The city is known for its vibrant culture, pleasant weather, and rich sporting history.
 
• Bangalore has been a prominent center for cricket in India, producing many renowned cricketers and hosting numerous international matches.
 
• The city is home to the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, a premier cricket venue that has hosted several memorable matches over the years.
